# Spencer

- **Role:** doctor  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P28](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Spencer possesses a benevolent face. Her expressions naturally convey warmth, often mingling surprise and welcome.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P0](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0000)_

## Personality

Spencer is characterized by her benevolent demeanor. She receives visitors with a welcoming and pleasantly surprised expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P0](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0000)_

## History

Spencer was involved in the orphan adoption mix-up that resulted in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) being sent to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the boy [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) had requested. When [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visited Spencer at [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) Cove to investigate how the error occurred, Spencer explained the situation. During this visit, Spencer facilitated an offer from Mrs. [Peter Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md), who expressed an eagerness to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a domestic helper.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P47](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER II. ### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is Spencer's daughter. Her mother resides at [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) Cove, where visitors arrive to investigate a child mix-up that Spencer was involved in.
